title: Scripted causal locomotion product episode
hypothesis: The all-joint production policy can remain physically stable and causally beneficial during a fully scripted stand-accelerate-cruise-turn-decelerate-stop-settle episode driven by the kinematic shell, with no human input and no bridge reset.
causal_test: Normal median locomotion stability-cost AUC must be at most 0.9 times ZeroActions median under an identical scripted shell trajectory.
absolute_acceptance: Normal completes all phases and returns to BalanceActive_Standing.
Path length, net displacement, and yaw satisfy the locked protocol.
Standing physics topology, support, target readback, inference, and collision contracts remain valid.
The final two-second settle window has zero shell speed and stable standing.
determinism: Normal and ZeroActions repetitions must be byte-identical for physics.jsonl, policy.jsonl, scenario-summary.json, and policy-input-snapshot.json.
stop_condition: Do not promote the milestone unless the complete 3+3+1+1 bundle passes and the source/model/protocol audit is valid.
